page.layout: One scanned image showing the bare edge of a book: a white paper strip on the left, the dark gutter and book-block shadow in the middle and right. No printed text blocks, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan shows no printed text. It contains only the fore-edge of paper, the binding and gutter shadow, a small dark ink spot on the white paper, and a few stains and show-through on the grey board at right. Nothing here is printed matter, so no transcription is given.
